notes.title: Improvements and Gameplay changes
notes.content:
In this update we fixed a bunch of bugs. Also we improved the gameplay mechanics a bit.

Changes:
- Every Character has now its own movement behavior. Which means it is now different.
- More shiny Camera
- Removed the Life System (as it had no sense) 

FIX:
- Several Level bugfixes like collisions and "too hard" levels
- WorldMap: Player no longer starts at level 2 and worldmap position starts at the correct position

To explain some of why this game is so weired sometimes:
I started developing in 2014 and was just my first big idea. The first version was initially released as an android game but then i decided to port this game to PC. With this there were more and more changes coming (as the android version had a "candy crush" like life system - 5 lifes and watch an add to get a an additional life). 

The Android game also had no character choices - there was just one (the girl).

So sorry for some weired behaviors - i tried to make not just a "cheap mobile" port of the game.
